## About
Houston Engine & Balancing Service is a family owned, full service machine shop that specializes in performance racing engines. We build engines for race categories in NHRA and IHRA, and we've earned a reputation for building some of the most reliable engines in the business.
Owner Jeff Toman runs the shop, and customers come to us for everything from race motors to street engines for daily drivers. We recently upgraded our facility and equipment and moved just around the corner from our old spot, to 610 Curtis Ave in Pasadena.
Customers have given us a 4.4 rating from 78 reviews on Google. If you have questions or ideas, Jeff is the one to talk to.

## Services
- Performance racing engines: Full engine builds focused on reliability and horsepower for competitive motorsport.
- Stuska engine dynamometer: Engine testing on our DEPAC equipped Stuska engine dynamometer.
- Cylinder head flow bench: Flow testing for cylinder heads as part of our cylinder head department.

## FAQ
Q: When is the shop open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:30 am to 5:30 pm. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We moved around the corner from our old location. You'll find us at 610 Curtis Ave, Pasadena, TX 77502.

Q: How long will my work take?
A: It might take a few extra days. It's pretty much a one man show here, so please call and ask about timing for your job.
